website-terms-of-use/privacy-policy.title: Privacy notice
website-terms-of-use/privacy-policy.intro: How information is used when you visit this website or contact us.
sections: Who to contact
This website is for Bitterne Park Dental Laboratory. For privacy questions, email lbiffen@gmail.com or call 023 8067 1836.
Browsing this website

The website is hosted using Cloudflare. Hosting services may process technical information, such as IP addresses and request details, to deliver and protect the website. This site does not include advertising trackers, analytics scripts or a patient portal.
Contacting us

When you telephone or email us, we receive the details you choose to provide. We use those details to respond to your enquiry and manage the arrangements you request. The website itself does not collect or store enquiry form submissions.
Email and clinical information

Email links open your email application. Please keep an initial enquiry to your name, contact details and a brief description of the service you need. Contact us to agree an appropriate way to share sensitive information.
Further privacy information

Please contact us for information about how your correspondence and any patient records are handled, including retention arrangements and requests relating to your personal information. This page describes this website; it is not a complete patient-record privacy notice.

website-terms-of-use/cookie-policy.title: Cookies & website storage
website-terms-of-use/cookie-policy.intro: A simple website without advertising or analytics cookies.
sections: What this website uses
The website code does not set cookies or use local storage. Fonts and images are served as part of the website. There are no embedded maps, videos, advertising trackers or analytics scripts.
Hosting services
Cloudflare provides website delivery and security. Any additional security features enabled by the site operator may affect cookie use. This notice should be updated if new features are introduced.
Contact links
Choosing an email link opens your email application; choosing a telephone link can open a calling application. Those applications operate under their own settings and privacy policies.

website-terms-of-use.title: Website information
website-terms-of-use.intro: Information about using this website and making an enquiry.
sections: Information on this website
The pages introduce the denture services offered by Bitterne Park Dental Laboratory. They do not provide an individual assessment or a guarantee that a particular product is suitable for you.

Please contact us to confirm service availability, home-visit coverage, prices and timescales. An enquiry does not confirm an appointment. Work and costs are agreed directly with you.

Appointments are by home visit only across Hampshire and Dorset. Repair collection and return can be arranged. Please contact us before travelling or sending dentures.
Questions or corrections
If you have a question about the information on this website, or believe something needs correcting, please email lbiffen@gmail.com or call 023 8067 1836.
